**Chinese name:** 上海概伦电子股份有限公司 (Gàilún Diànzǐ)

::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
STAR-listed (688206, January 2022) specialist in the most physics-heavy corner of EDA — compact modeling/TCAD and memory design tools, the layer where Synopsys/Cadence still set the bar — that pivoted in 2026 into consolidation: its purchase of analog-IP vendor 锐成芯微 (100%) and its subsidiary 纳能微 (45.64%) for ~¥2.17bn in shares and cash cleared CSRC registration on 26 June 2026 (证监许可〔2026〕1505号, ~6 months from acceptance to approval), assets transferred by 31 July, and 67.5m new shares registered at ¥17.42 in mid-August with a ≤¥1.05bn matching financing still in progress — the template deal for Beijing's push to build scale domestic EDA champions. The organic business remains small: H1 2026 revenue ¥2.40亿 (+10.1%) swinging to a ¥6.7m net loss (deal fees, lower investment income), with domestic EDA license revenue +19.8% and test systems +31.1% and R&D at 55.9% of revenue.
:::

## What does this firm design?

EDA tools (device characterization, compact models, memory and power-semiconductor flows, DTCO) and, post-deal, 1,000+ physical IP packages across 30+ global foundry processes licensed to chip designers.
